entry_sequence.action: we want to take our support and resistance line and we want to mark that highest point of price action and we want to mark that lowest point of price action

what we are going to wait for is one for either price to break above that range or we are going to look for price to break below that range. Now if we can actually get that break we want to see it close below or above with strength or weakness

if for example if we're breaking below well then we want to see a break below with weakness. If we see a break above well then we want to look for price to break above with strength. If we are actually able to do that then that is actual confirmation that price is likely going to break and continue in that direction
when we get that break with strength or weakness, we are then going to look for price to pull back and retest that level

if we break above the overnight highs, we want to see it break with strength above, but then we want to see it pull back and test this area as support. So when it pulls back, we want to see some kind of bullish price action, whether it be a bullish hammer, uh bullish engulfing, dragonfly dogee, long lower wicks, and an elevation in the volume. If we can get that, we are then going to look for a long entry

If price were to break below this level again, we're going to look for it to break with weakness. We then want to see price come back up, test this area as resistance with bearish price action, whether it be uh bearish hammer, gravestone dogee, long upper wick, bearish engulfing, as well as an elevation in the volume. Well, if we get that, we are going to look for a short entry to take price lower

confluences.description: we want to see some kind of bullish price action, whether it be a bullish hammer, uh bullish engulfing, dragonfly dogee, long lower wicks (for longs) / bearish hammer, gravestone dogee, long upper wick, bearish engulfing (for shorts)

the overall trend is going to be very important when dictating are we looking for price to break above the range or are we looking for price to break below the range. if the overall trend is to the upside, well then ideally we're not looking for price to break below to look for shorts. Ideally we're waiting for price to break above to look for longs. Or if the overall trend is very weak, well then ideally we're looking for the market to break below this level and continue lower

targets.description: once you feel comfortable with your first trim, take it, put your stop-loss at break even
it is also very important to let your winners run until one, you're satisfied with the trade or two, you're stopped out in profits

stop.anchor: our stop is going to be if price breaks back down below this previous high (long) / our stop is going to be if price breaks above this level (short). Your stop loss is always on the opposite side of the breakout point
